task_packs.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1 · engineering 15
task_packs.curated_selection: Fifteen verified upstream task IDs selected for software engineering, debugging, systems, security, databases, and serving coverage. This is an application cohort, not an official Terminal-Bench score.
task_packs.success_criteria: The task's trusted upstream Harbor verifier must return a passing reward after the agent finishes.
task_packs.verifier_asset_policy: Download verifier and oracle assets only into the isolated runner; never return them from public problem APIs or model context.
limitations: The Harbor runner adapter and container/image compatibility have not yet been integrated into this application.
Every converted task must pass an oracle run and fail a no-op run before this pack can become launchable.
Results from this curated cohort are not an official Terminal-Bench aggregate.

task_packs.name: Aider Polyglot · balanced 12
task_packs.license: Source repository license not declared; task component licenses require per-task review; Harbor adapter Apache-2.0
task_packs.curated_selection: Two real Harbor registry tasks per language, selected deterministically from C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust. It is a fast language-coverage cohort, not an official Aider leaderboard score.
task_packs.success_criteria: All trusted exercise tests selected by the upstream Harbor verifier must pass after the edit.
task_packs.verifier_asset_policy: Keep exercise tests and reference patches in the isolated runner; expose only the prompt and declared editable surface to the model.
limitations: This balanced cohort is not difficulty-stratified and is not comparable to the official 225-task Aider leaderboard.
Converted assets are revision-pinned but have not yet been imported, license-audited, or validated in this application.
Every converted task must pass an oracle run and fail a no-op run before this pack can become launchable.

task_packs.name: Aider Polyglot · Python canary 3
task_packs.license: MIT task components from Exercism Python and problem-specifications; Apache-2.0 Harbor adapter
task_packs.curated_selection: Three real Python editing exercises selected from the pinned 225-task Harbor conversion: zipper and zebra-puzzle overlap the balanced-12 cohort, while wordy adds a deeper parser and error-semantics workload. The selected upstream Git-tree attestation is sha256:373c1a204c4ec13e778200683784faba7d49e7bb11895ba9294f2349b47f2502. This is a fast application canary, not an official Aider score.
task_packs.success_criteria: Every task must pass all assertions adapted from its trusted pinned upstream test file after the edit; the exact pinned exemplar must pass and the untouched starter must fail.
task_packs.verifier_asset_policy: Only the instruction, starter, and generic candidate RPC runner enter the agent sandbox. Root-only verifier drivers run candidate modules as uid/gid 65534 in a fresh network-disabled clean room. Exact exemplar oracles are eligibility-only and never enter agent or verifier runtime.
limitations: This 3-of-225 Python-only canary is not difficulty-stratified and cannot be compared with official Aider Polyglot leaderboard scores.
The application adapter uses an immutable Python 3.12 slim runtime instead of Harbor's moving buildpack-deps:jammy plus Python 3.11 PPA build.
The generic RPC runner is public but contains no test cases or expected values; verifier assertions remain protected.

task_packs.name: FeatureBench · fast 100 reference
task_packs.curated_selection: The official CPU-only fast split is recorded as a future full cohort; no application-specific subset has been selected.
task_packs.success_criteria: The official FeatureBench harness must accept the patch under its hidden test and feature-resolution metrics.
task_packs.verifier_asset_policy: Use FeatureBench's official isolated evaluation path and do not expose gold patches or hidden tests to the model or public API.
limitations: Harbor's registry entry referenced HEAD rather than an immutable converted-task commit when this manifest was authored, so those converted assets are intentionally not accepted.
The official FeatureBench CLI, images, and result schema have not yet been adapted to this application's run controller.
This entry is reference-only and cannot be launched.
